name: Randy Ed.
source:
Cyborg

A cyborg whose human life was turned upside down thanks to Seon Corp., namely Lien Lei.

He is a steadfast friend to Angel and forced lackey of Lien. His hacking ability makes him a valuable ally and his humor a necessity for lightening the mood.

[From [url=http://altabestudio.com/works/ea-pinocchio/]official site[/url]]
